purpose: Teach: 双眼鏡/冷や汗/有難い/北口/出だし/オリジナリティ/平地/飛び降り

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、双眼鏡、絶対、ぼく、絶対、貸してもらった
lines.en: Mom — I really, seriously borrowed Dad's binoculars. I did.
lines.style: Urgent, staccato bursts of conviction. Six-year-old breathlessness. Leans forward. Each phrase feels like he needs you to believe him right now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、緊張で、絶対、冷や汗、絶対、出ること、絶対、誰でもあるわよ
lines.en: Sho, sweating from nerves happens to everyone. That's just how people are.
lines.style: Warm and steady, like she's seen this worry a hundred times. Gentle, not dismissive. She kneels to his eye level. The reassurance of knowing exactly what he needs to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママの、本気で、絶対、有難い、絶対、お言葉、絶対、ぼく、絶対、元気が出るよ
lines.en: Your kind words really help me feel better, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Small, unprompted gratitude. The kind of thing he means completely but almost whispers, surprised by his own feeling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 駅の、本気で、絶対、北口、絶対、で、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、待ち合わせよ、翔くん
lines.en: We're meeting Dad at the north exit of the station, Sho.
lines.style: Practical, shift-gears tone. Not dismissive of what came before, just moving forward. The way a parent changes subject when comfort is done and information is needed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの作文の、絶対、出だし、絶対、上手にできたよ
lines.en: Mom, the beginning of my essay turned out really well.
lines.style: Small pride in his voice. Not bragging — just stating fact quietly, looking for confirmation. The vulnerability of showing you something he worked on.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの絵に、本気で、絶対、オリジナリティ、絶対、感じるわ
lines.en: I really do see originality in your drawings, Sho.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, not performed. She means it completely. The kind of specific praise that lands because she noticed something real, not generic.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、田舎の、絶対、平地、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちで、絶対、走り回ったよ
lines.en: I ran all around at Grandpa's house out in the countryside.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. The memory of freedom. His voice opens up — wide spaces in his chest. Rapid, happy pace. Kid-energy returned.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、高いところから、絶対、飛び降りる、絶対、ような、絶対、こと、絶対、しないでね
lines.en: But don't jump down from high places like that, okay Sho?
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Not fear in her voice, but clear boundary. Close, intimate — the kind of safety instruction delivered with a hand on his shoulder, not a lecture.
